It shows bright gold, ringed in white, on the little drawing above. At the door, pulling this book opens it: you go home, and a visitor knocks.
Other labelled books (they open nothing; a visitor sees every title and has to guess)
Every place on the shelves has a labelled book already.
All the labelled books are bound alike. A book with no title typed is left off the shelf, and two books cannot share a place.
